entities.name: Motora Yūjirō
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yūjirō Motora, sometimes also known as Yuzero Motora, was a Japanese experimental psychologist. He was one of the earliest Japanese psychologists. He was known for conducting research on the attention spans of school-aged children, and he set up the first psychological laboratory in Japan.

entities.name: Motora Yūjirō
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yūjirō Motora, sometimes also known as Yuzero Motora, was a Japanese experimental psychologist. He was one of the earliest Japanese psychologists. He was known for conducting research on the attention spans of school-aged children, and he set up the first psychological laboratory in Japan.
